row.notes: Whole body read. Seeds an MT19937 from rec vfunc +0x90(3) + u16 rec+0x2a, shuffles the gain_list items (count at +0x100; item = type byte, amount in the high 32 bits) and applies each one: types 0..11 call Career_ResourcePoints_CollectForTypePair(rec+0x18, key rec+0x28, weekend 2 or 3, type, paired type); types 12+ add the amount to the matching 0x30-byte entry of the session record (int +0x20, flag +0x24). After each item it sums the session record (entries with type < 0xe: round(count * +0x10 + +0x14), clamped to +0x18..+0x1c) and, when the sum exceeds the cap rec+0x30, undoes the item (zero the entry or subtract the amount); otherwise types 12 and 13 post a bus message (vtable 0x1458504f0). Caller Career_ResourcePoints_RecalcSessionTotal calls it last, after computing rec+0x2c and the cap rec+0x30. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
